children.text: Wow... im surprised that you found this... like its invisible and hidden in a wall... well ill tell you something then.... I made this all invisible because.... THE AGENTS!!!! THEY ARE COMING!!! RUN!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Wow its already done! Fun. How many tries did it take you to pass this? Probably a lot but if this is the first try then its cool! I want you to take a little break from the stress, take a deep breath, breathe out. Now you should try to pop your knuckles, they may have have recharged.
